name: URY Expiring Documents
query:
SELECT document_code AS `Document Code`, title AS `Title`, category AS `Category`, status AS `Status`, branch AS `Branch`, restaurant AS `Restaurant`, expiry_date AS `Expiry Date`, next_review_date AS `Next Review Date`, document_owner AS `Owner`
FROM `tabURY Controlled Document`
WHERE status IN ('Published', 'Approved', 'Expired')
  AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR expiry_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR expiry_date <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(branch)s IS NULL OR branch = %(branch)s)
  AND (%(category)s IS NULL OR category = %(category)s)
ORDER BY expiry_date ASC
